svg.title: The evidence ladder
svg.desc: Three kinds of evidence behind every validation claim. Layer 1: reproduces an archived product, cell by cell; reached only by the earlier v3.1.4 translation (not shipped) on ORACLES 2D-S and HVPS, so 0 of the 70 shipped-engine coverage cells. Layer 2: matches the original source executing, Octave for UIOPS and GDL for SODA-2; reached by both shipped engines, 49 cells cross-checked. Layer 3: adjudicated by eye in the particle viewer, with n and the labeller stated; the only evidence for data with no product of record, such as ARM.
svg.text: THE EVIDENCE LADDER — THREE DIFFERENT QUESTIONS, NOT THREE GRADES OF ONE
Layer 1 — reproduces an archived product, cell by cell
Checked against a product a campaign actually published.
Reached by: the earlier v3.1.4 translation only (not shipped), on ORACLES 2D-S / HVPS.
Layer 2 — matches the original source executing
GNU Octave runs UIOPS's own .m files; GDL runs SODA-2's own .pro files. No licence needed.
Reached by: both shipped engines, v3.5 and SODA-2; no archive was ever written by either.
Layer 3 — adjudicated by eye, n and labeller stated
A person judges the particle images directly in the particle viewer.
The only evidence for new data with no product of record and no original run, such as ARM's.
Other cells: 0 refuse by design, 5 are not built, 0 refuse on a defect, 16 are untested. Full grid: COVERAGE_MATRIX.md
